sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test imports
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the locale helpers, and the translation function.
sections.why: Lets the tests check the locale helpers and the translated text.
sections.watch_out: The imported names must match the exports in the locale file, or the tests will not run.

sections.name: locale hydration contract
sections.title: Locale startup and saved value checks
sections.what: Checks that the default language is English and that the skip link text is correct. Confirms the storage key name. Confirms that only English or Hindi are accepted as saved values, and that anything else returns nothing.
sections.why: Keeps the first page render stable and stops invalid saved values from changing the language.
sections.watch_out: A changed storage key would silently forget every visitor's saved language choice.

summary: Tests that the language setting starts with English on the server and first render, uses the right storage key, and accepts only English or Hindi as saved values.
purpose: Protects the rule that the server and first browser render agree on the language, which prevents display mismatches.
why: Likely reason: a mismatch between server and browser content causes errors in the page, so a test guards it. The file itself states this as the contract.
how: Checks the default language is English, that the English label for the skip link is correct, and that the storage key name is fixed. Then checks that only Hindi and English are recognised as saved values, and that other values or no value return nothing.
inputs: The exported default language, storage key, and saved-value reader from the locale context, and the translation function.
outputs: Pass or fail results for the tests.
risks: Changing the default language or the storage key will fail these tests on purpose, and saved user choices under the old key would be lost.
debug: If a test fails, check whether the default or the storage key changed on purpose. If the skip link text fails, check the translation file.
